He is a co-founder of HIVE, an environmentally focused synthetic biology institute at HMS, and an Associate Member of the Broad Institute of Harvard and MIT. Michael received his BS in Chemistry and BS in Biology from Stanford University, and was awarded his Ph.D. for doctoral studies in the field of cell biology at the University of California, San Francisco.
